# streamerOS

> streamerOS (streamerosai.com) is a Windows desktop app for Twitch and YouTube streamers. It automates OBS Studio from live chat, shows chat, Super Chat revenue and sentiment in one window, marks hype spikes for clips and tracks sponsor deals, all on the streamer's own PC with no account. Built by Yaseen Khatib. Launching November 2026. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time $29 licence, not a subscription.

streamerOS is not affiliated with other projects or websites using a similar name, including the StreamerOS hackathon project on Devpost, streameros.com and getstreameros.com.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11 only. macOS and Linux are not part of v1.0.
- OBS integration: OBS WebSocket v5 on the local machine, no plugin.
- Automation: Auto-Hype Director rules trigger on chat velocity or Super Chats crossing a threshold the streamer sets. Actions: switch OBS scene, play a sound, change overlay mood, mute or unmute an input, save the replay buffer, post to a Discord webhook.
- Privacy: no account and no streamerOS backend. Chat is read and scored on the PC. The app connects out only for features the user enables, listed in the privacy policy.
- Performance: built in Rust and Tauri rather than Electron.
- AI: local models through Ollama. Chat sentiment understands Hinglish; the assistant replies in English.
- Pricing: 7-day free trial with no card, then $29 once. Pre-registering before launch extends the trial to 3 months.
